expectations.text: Frames recognition only as a deliberately chosen structure rather than a fallback or a downgrade
expectations.evidence: Section 1 lists recognition fourth, as 'Recognition only. A trophy, a title, or a public write-up works if you can't get any of the above. It's a legitimate choice, not a failure.' The 'not a failure' line pushes back on the downgrade reading. But the conditional 'if you can't get any of the above' and its last place in an ordered list frame it as a fallback, not as a structure picked on purpose for its own merits.

expectations.text: Frames recognition only as a deliberately chosen structure rather than a fallback or a downgrade
expectations.evidence: The transcript never presents a recognition-only prize, such as a title, shout-out or non-cash award, as an option. Every option it lists still moves the 500 EUR: the donor pays directly, a nonprofit host pays out, or the group forms a VZW. Since recognition-only never appears, the answer doesn't frame it as a deliberate choice, and it doesn't frame it as a downgrade either.
